meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先读仓库状态再动手:按仓库已有风格做原子提交、改写分支历史(squash/fixup),或用 log/blame/bisect 查历史。没让你做的提交、推送、重置等写操作不会执行。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码、改写分支历史,或调查某处改动的来源时触发;普通代码编辑不适用。

say.text: 把这几个改动拆成原子提交,信息风格跟仓库现有的一致
say.note: 按行为分组逐个提交,最后回报哈希

say.text: 查一下 src/auth.js 第 40-60 行最后是谁改的
say.note: 用 git blame 给出提交哈希和行上下文

say.text: 把我这两个 fixup 提交自动压进对应的提交
say.note: 用 autosquash 改写,冲突按意图解决

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads repo state first: atomic commits in your repo's style, rebases or squashes, and history answers via log/blame/bisect. Write operations happen only when you ask for them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit, a branch-history rewrite, or a Git-history question; ordinary code edits are out of scope.

say_en.text: Split these changes into atomic commits using the repo's own message style
say_en.note: Groups by behavior, commits each, reports hashes

say_en.text: Who last changed lines 40-60 of src/auth.js?
say_en.note: git blame with hash and line context

say_en.text: Squash these fixup commits into their targets
say_en.note: Autosquash rewrite; conflicts resolved by intent
